"'''Personality'''" is a [[1959 in music|1959]] song with [[music]] and [[lyrics]] by Harold Logan and [[Lloyd Price]]. It was released as a single by Price,<ref name=pc17>{{Gilliland |url=https://digital.library.unt.edu/ark:/67531/metadc19767/m1/ |title=Show 17 - The Soul Reformation: More on the evolution of rhythm and blues. [Part 3]  |date=2013-05-28 |accessdate=2013-06-10}}</ref> and became one of Lloyd Price's most popular crossover hits.  The single reached number 2 for three weeks on the [[Billboard Hot 100]], kept from the number 1 spot by "[[The Battle of New Orleans]]" by [[Johnny Horton]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/1959-06-15|title=The Hot 100 Chart|website=Billboard.com}}</ref>  The song was also a number 1 [[United States|U.S.]] R&B hit, maintaining the top spot for four weeks.<ref>{{cite book |title= Top R&B/Hip-Hop Singles: 1942-2004|last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=470}}</ref>  ''Billboard'' ranked it as the [[Billboard Year-End Hot 100 singles of 1959|number 3 song for 1959]], with the number 1 slot going to "The Battle of New Orleans". The song reached number 9 in the [[UK Singles Chart]].<ref>[http://musicvf.com/song.php?id=26260 "Personality" by Lloyd Price], Musicvf.com, Retrieved March 18, 2012.</ref>

"Personality" is a 1959 song with music and lyrics by Harold Logan and Lloyd Price. It was released as a single by Price, and became one of Lloyd Price's most popular crossover hits.  The single reached number 2 for three weeks on the Billboard Hot 100, kept from the number 1 spot by "The Battle of New Orleans" by Johnny Horton.  The song was also a number 1 U.S. R&B hit, maintaining the top spot for four weeks.  Billboard ranked it as the number 3 song for 1959, with the number 1 slot going to "The Battle of New Orleans". The song reached number 9 in the UK Singles Chart.

sections.heading: Cover versions
sections.wikitext:
*A version by [[Anthony Newley]] reached number 6 in the United Kingdom in June 1959.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.officialcharts.com/artist/7135/anthony-newley/|title=ANTHONY NEWLEY | full Official Chart History | Official Charts Company|website=Officialcharts.com}}</ref>
*In 1959, Argentinian singer [[Billy Caffaro]], edited the Spanish version "Personalidad". 
*As "Personalità", performed by [[Caterina Valente]], it was a major Italian hit in 1960.
*In 1967, [[Mitch Ryder]] got to number 87 with a live medley of this song and "[[Chantilly Lace (song)|Chantilly Lace]]".
*In 1974, [[Jackie Robinson (musician)|Jackie Robinson]], lead singer of [[The Pioneers (band)|The Pioneers]], released a reggae version in the UK on [[Trojan Records]]' subsidiary label Horse.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.discogs.com/release/4132305-Jackie-Robinson-2-The-All-Stars-Personality-Stone-Cold |title=Jackie Robinson (2) / The All Stars (37) – Personality / Stone Cold |website=Discogs |year=1974 |access-date=July 7, 2022 }}</ref>
*[[Jerry Lee Lewis]] released a [[country and western]] version on his 1979 album, ''Jerry Lee Lewis''.<ref>[http://www.allmusic.com/album/jerry-lee-lewis-r11637 Jerry Lee Lewis, ''Jerry Lee Lewis''], [[AllMusic]], Retrieved March 18, 2012.</ref>
*[[Svenne & Lotta]] on their LP album ''Bring It On Home'' 1978

sections.heading: Song in popular culture
sections.wikitext:
A version of the song is heard in a [[2010 in television|2010]] [[TV commercial]] for [[NFLShop.com]]. the [[NFL]]'s online retailer and also appears on the soundtrack of [[2011 in film|2011]] film ''[[The Help (film)|The Help]]''.<ref>{{cite web|title=The Help (Music From the Motion Picture)|url=https://www.amazon.com/Help-Music-Motion-Picture/dp/B0055FDMRI|website=Amazon.com|accessdate=January 30, 2012|date=July 26, 2011}}</ref>

[[Annie Ross]] performed the song for the 1991 horror film ''[[Basket Case 3: The Progeny]]''.
